pattern: Generated cards give themselves away by over-staging. They show the whole object small in a diorama (island rocks, houses, fence, bushes), add props the subject doesn't name (life ring, map, watering can, trowel), crowd the scene with many small leaves and foam lines, and put a bright glowing halo behind the hero. Real cards crop close so the card edge cuts the object, keep the place to a few large quiet shapes, and keep the field evenly toned.
